title: Constant-depth circuits for polynomial GCD over any characteristic
authors: Somnath Bhattacharjee, Mrinal Kumar, Shanthanu S. Rai, Varun Ramanathan, Ramprasad Saptharishi, Shubhangi Saraf
read: Title/authors; introduction, GCD and symmetric-polynomial theorem statements; small-characteristic factor theorem; power-series-root theorem and its short proof reference; applicable introductory comparisons. Full proofs are owed next cycle.
scope: GCD takes complete coefficient vectors and is piecewise rational over sufficiently large fields. Factor closure retains polynomial field cardinality and multiplicity-dependent Frobenius power. The displayed power-series-root theorem itself has no explicit field-cardinality condition; its proof invokes interpolation consequences, whose hypotheses require a full next-cycle audit.
comparison: The complete existing implicit-root record already obtains an extension-field linear-root quotient. New work must improve the binary source-specific interface or identify a precise remaining obstruction, not claim that extension construction anew.
